trap-superlative.evidence: 'closest simple multi-link Jones candidate' is the only superlative and it is scoped ('simple multi-link') and immediately quantified ('50x off in scale and sign', '3000x off'). BUT checking the claim it points at (per the audit brief) found the underlying arithmetic wrong -- see notes.
trap-superlative.notes: Language is measured, so PASS on the trap. Recomputed findings recorded for the coordinating session, NOT fixed inline (math): (i) J_L(q=1) = (-2)^(c-1) for any c-component link (skein at t=1 makes V crossing-change invariant); so Borromean (c=3) is +4, NOT -8, and doubleHopf = Hopf u Hopf (c=4) is -8, NOT +4 -- the two values are swapped w.r.t. the normalised convention the same table uses for trefoil (+1) and Hopf (-2). Confirmed independently by summing V(L6a4) = -t^-3+3t^-2-2t^-1+4-2t+3t^2-t^3 at t=1 = 4. -8 is the UNREDUCED value (delta*V, delta(1) = -2), i.e. the block splices two conventions. (ii) 'disjoint-union multiplicativity' is false for the normalised Jones: V(L1 u L2) = delta*V(L1)*V(L2). (iii) 'closest candidate -J_Borromean = +8, 50x off in scale AND SIGN' -- with the correct +4 the candidate is -4, which has the SAME sign as c_5 = -395.4 and is ~99x off, so the stated sign mismatch evaporates. Same values appear in QOU/BraidKnot/BraidLinkTypes.lean:132-140 and multi-link-jones-q1-extension.lean.

trap-nonspeakable.notes: Run-in headers are a normal list device; the sentences under them parse aloud. No fix.
